metadata.description: Free, open-source Claude Code skills and plugins by Bubble Invest — the Bubble shop for agentic workflows.

plugins.name: suno-extract
plugins.description: Extract the MP3 from any Suno song URL via the public API. No key needed.

plugins.name: telegram-reporter
plugins.description: Send Telegram messages from any script or cron via curl. Reads a bot token from a config file.

plugins.name: scheduled-task-creation
plugins.description: Step-by-step guide for creating and debugging Claude Desktop scheduled tasks (local routines).

plugins.name: notion-linker
plugins.description: Automatically link published content (articles, posts) back to project rows in a Notion database.

plugins.name: generate-image
plugins.description: Generate images locally with FLUX.2 Klein via mflux on Apple Silicon. Free, offline, no API calls.

plugins.name: notion-reader
plugins.description: Query a Notion database or page from any script. Reads a token from config; DB/page IDs via env vars.

plugins.name: voice-transcribe
plugins.description: Transcribe voice notes / audio files to text locally and offline (whisper.cpp, no API key) — Telegram .oga, wav, mp3, flac. FR/EN/auto.

plugins.name: longform-video
plugins.description: Turn an article into a 1-5 min narrated landscape video essay: Remotion + local TTS voice cloning + Pexels b-roll + kinetic typography. Fully local voice, no cloud TTS.

plugins.name: deepseek-brain
plugins.description: Switch a Claude Code agent's LLM backend from Anthropic to DeepSeek while keeping the full harness. Covers the reasoning-effort proxy, model routing, channels fix, and rollback.

plugins.name: fund-source-verification
plugins.description: Source-tier classification + independent-verification rubric for any external signal before you act on it. Tier gating, corroboration math, paywall discipline.

plugins.name: fund-thesis-format
plugins.description: A canonical 7-part investment thesis structure (claim, mechanism, fit, invalidation, sizing, asymmetry, conviction levers) that renders at three depths: reference file, memo, chat.

plugins.name: cron-preflight
plugins.description: Pre-flight scaffolding for scheduled tasks: catch-up SKEW math (machine slept through the window), policy-doc hash gate, source verifier. Abort / soft-mute / weekly-abort modes.

plugins.name: cron-postflight
plugins.description: Post-flight scaffolding for scheduled tasks: audit-log row, git commit + push with lane discipline, notification send. Companion to cron-preflight.

plugins.name: publish-substack-note
plugins.description: Publish a short-form Substack Note with an optional hero image via the Claude-in-Chrome extension (Playwright gets 403 on Substack).

plugins.name: publish-substack-post
plugins.description: Publish or schedule a long-form Substack Post with inline images, hero image, and subscribe button, via a logged-in Playwright browser profile. Selectors + timing that actually work.

plugins.name: local-tts
plugins.description: Local text-to-speech (VoxCPM2, 30 languages, voice cloning). Free, offline, Apple Silicon.

plugins.name: boycott-filter
plugins.description: Personal boycott enforcer — tell your agent which brands to avoid; a Chrome extension warns you on their pages with your own reasons.

plugins.name: bubble-shield
plugins.description: PreToolUse guard that blocks reads of protected client folders until data is anonymised through Bubble Shield. 100% local, reversible, fail-closed (GDPR/RGPD art. 25 & 32).

plugins.name: prospect-research
plugins.description: Build or refresh a structured Research Capsule for any sales prospect: background, workflow pain points, recent signals, and three outreach angles (V1/V2/V3). Writes a local Markdown file. Read-only on social sources — never sends or posts anything.
